rules.title: Damage/security deposit
rules.lesson_plain: A landlord cannot require a damage/security deposit. A lawful rent deposit and the regulated refundable key deposit are different.
rules.lesson_simple_english: A landlord cannot require a damage/security deposit. A lawful rent deposit and the regulated refundable key deposit are different.

rules.title: Excess rent deposit
rules.lesson_plain: A required rent deposit is capped at the lesser of one rent period and one month. Compare any stated dollar deposit to the actual rent.
rules.lesson_simple_english: A required rent deposit is capped at the lesser of one rent period and one month. Compare any stated dollar deposit to the actual rent.

rules.title: No-pets provision
rules.lesson_plain: A tenancy agreement cannot ban animals. Other animal-related laws and grounds for an LTB application may still matter.
rules.lesson_simple_english: A tenancy agreement cannot ban animals. Other animal-related laws and grounds for an LTB application may still matter.

rules.title: Required automatic payment/post-dated cheques
rules.lesson_plain: A landlord cannot require post-dated cheques or automatic payments. A voluntary arrangement is different.
rules.lesson_simple_english: A landlord cannot require post-dated cheques or automatic payments. A voluntary arrangement is different.

rules.title: Unrestricted entry
rules.lesson_plain: Ordinary entry under s.27 requires at least 24 hours written notice and a permitted reason. Section 26 permits exceptions, including emergencies and consent at entry.
rules.lesson_simple_english: Ordinary entry under s.27 requires at least 24 hours written notice and a permitted reason. Section 26 permits exceptions, including emergencies and consent at entry.

rules.title: Maintenance duty waiver
rules.lesson_plain: A landlord remains responsible for repair, habitation and required standards. An agreement cannot waive the Act.
rules.lesson_simple_english: A landlord remains responsible for repair, habitation and required standards. An agreement cannot waive the Act.

rules.title: Self-help eviction/lockout
rules.lesson_plain: A landlord cannot recover possession of an occupied unit without a Board order, except abandonment/vacating; changing locks requires replacement keys.
rules.lesson_simple_english: A landlord cannot recover possession of an occupied unit without a Board order, except abandonment/vacating; changing locks requires replacement keys.

rules.title: Rent-deposit interest/use
rules.lesson_plain: Rent-deposit interest is due annually at the guideline rate. A rent deposit is for the last rent period, not a general non-refundable fee.
rules.lesson_simple_english: Rent-deposit interest is due annually at the guideline rate. A rent deposit is for the last rent period, not a general non-refundable fee.

rules.title: Standard lease information
rules.lesson_plain: Prescribed classes of tenancies require the prescribed agreement form. This lesson does not assume every sublet is a prescribed tenancy.
rules.lesson_simple_english: Prescribed classes of tenancies require the prescribed agreement form. This lesson does not assume every sublet is a prescribed tenancy.

rules.title: Sublet consent
rules.lesson_plain: Subletting requires landlord consent; a landlord shall not arbitrarily or unreasonably withhold consent to a potential subtenant.
rules.lesson_simple_english: Subletting requires landlord consent; a landlord shall not arbitrarily or unreasonably withhold consent to a potential subtenant.

rules.title: Owner-shared kitchen/bath exemption
rules.lesson_plain: The Act may not apply where sharing a kitchen or bathroom with the resident owner or specified family is required. Confirm who lives in the building.
rules.lesson_simple_english: The Act may not apply where sharing a kitchen or bathroom with the resident owner or specified family is required. Confirm who lives in the building.

rules.title: Refundable key deposit
rules.lesson_plain: A refundable key/device/card deposit may not exceed expected direct replacement cost. The amount and refundability need checking.
rules.lesson_simple_english: A refundable key/device/card deposit may not exceed expected direct replacement cost. The amount and refundability need checking.
